title: Use the minimum physical odd scale in the interleaved construction
body:
The exact interleaved graph can use native odd scale **176,715** in place of **2,650,725**. With binary height 21 and the source root format retained, the complete ordinary bill lowers its conservative scalar-service rate from `2^30` to `2^26`. This is a factor of 16 reduction in one bound coefficient. It is not a measured runtime or total-cost gain. **No new kappa** follows; every paid and productive job is unchanged.

This enabling proof resolves the physical-scale question in [PR #7726](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7726). Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5a71d8f0b2ae30f72b8d7f616048127c06e8dc5/research/interleaved-minimal-odd-scale/PROOF.md), [complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5a71d8f0b2ae30f72b8d7f616048127c06e8dc5/research/interleaved-minimal-odd-scale/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5a71d8f0b2ae30f72b8d7f616048127c06e8dc5/research/interleaved-minimal-odd-scale/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5a71d8f0b2ae30f72b8d7f616048127c06e8dc5/research/interleaved-minimal-odd-scale/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5a71d8f0b2ae30f72b8d7f616048127c06e8dc5/research/interleaved-minimal-odd-scale/CREDITS.md). The source already reported the normalized minimum product grid 723824640. This PR binds its odd part to physical components, per-call cleanup, the common root and the complete finite bill.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Every separate coefficient product and public endpoint | 10,483,566 products; all 1,260 endpoints |
| Sharp physical necessity | Explicit witnesses for 3, 5, 7, 11 and 17; every scale missing one required prime fails |
| Scalar implementation | 1,108 factors; 6,648 signed cases; maximum coefficient bits 22 → 18 |
| Complete 16-call invoice | 96,512 paid jobs, 17,296 productive jobs; unchanged |
| Ordinary charges | 123,035,648 scalar services, 47,392 odd conversions; all counts and layout formulas unchanged |
| Physical storage | All retirement and guards restored; live-sender overwrite and partial-clear controls reject |

The exact graph is `ba59d5db17c40185c8608a734ced10135d8c041e432c3840e9034868781c31a2`. The universal minimum uses arbitrary independent native inputs and the inherited complete Gaussian-dyadic chart contract. It does not assert a minimum for a restricted correlated caller. The storage fixture has four addressed cells per home; whole-extent behavior remains inherited. The source constructor and physical/caller engines are shared dependencies.

The general scale theorem and verifier structure come from [PR #7718](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7718), [pinned proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ceed7f9c4050060aa8a9c4149c704e6151555e5b/research/quotient-split-minimal-odd-scale/PROOF.md). Retain Gareth Davidson / bitplane's grid criterion in [PR #866](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/866), Ali Romman's [PR #7680](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7680) coefficient witnesses, and the [common-root proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/odd-native-common-grid/PROOF.md). The retained notices preserve icekylinx, Clear1nsight, DreamingOfClouds, SYLforge, Rohan Arun, Jerry Chen / CubeJerry, Douglas Colkitt and all predecessor credit.

The source scientific commit is `3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3`, published at `925719c8ae6d43216ff1f2a87c8da15f12525081`; its [source credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/CREDITS.md) identify the construction and Codex assistance. This PR starts from canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. All 63 retained files are byte-pinned. The pending source commits are copied dependencies, not asserted publication ancestry.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/interleaved-minimal-odd-scale
```

Both normal and optimized runs print:

```text
PASS_MINIMAL_ODD_PHYSICAL_SUBSTITUTION 176715 16
```

Normal and optimized replay, commit-byte/source-history/mode checks, export verification and a read-only sealed serial replay pass. The exported replay used no Git and left all hashes and modes unchanged. Separate rational columns and actual physical chart amplitudes check the five prime witnesses. Contract controls cover nonunit charts, correlated input cancellation and a unitary phase with an odd denominator.

The five native/owned/compiler/precision/analytic interfaces remain conditional. The original root bound and compiler H remain conservative. Full phase catalogue, compiler search, historical suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. This is author verification with reused engines, not blind, independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. The selected frontier is unchanged. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44378499281/job/135063992674) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19715963).
